comment: Error thresholds for the analytical comparison, keyed by the build
configuration. A null threshold means the value is recorded and printed
but not judged; poroelastic and viscoelastic have no material for the mini
meshes yet, so they have not been measured. The others are 1.5 times the
largest error measured with GCC 16 and Clang 22 for hsw and GCC 16 for
skx, rounded up; the spread between these is below 1e-3 of the error,
which the discretization, not the rounding, dominates. To measure again,
run ctest -L convergence with SEISSOL_RECORD_THRESHOLDS=1, which writes
the observed values next to each case.
Use the relative norms: the absolute ones scale with the amplitude of
the initial condition. L1 and L2 are reduced with MPI_SUM and are
therefore not reproducible across rank counts; LInf uses MPI_MAX and is.
